sourceEntry: 2026-10-28 — Business research in Notes and CI repair (local source)
releaseSummary: Find business details still fills blank fields from Google Places. It always adds a written market-intel profile (what they do, services, brands, online presence, recent news, published contact details) with source links under the contact's existing Notes; Save keeps it. In the contacts list, select up to 25 contacts and use Add market intel to notes to save it to each one directly. Needs the crm-enrich-contacts deploy and OPENAI_API_KEY for the web part. Not deployed or run against live providers.
